title: 🌱 Field Notice
body:
Welcome to o-vvv-o. 🌱

This is a small field for notes, links and memories. Think of it like Apple Notes or Stickies, but spatial: your notes live as sparkles in the field.

How to use it:
• Copy text or a link.
• Walk to a spot in the field.
• Press DIG three times.
• If something can be buried, the 🪏 shovel appears. Tap it to bury your note as a sparkle.
• Walk to a sparkle and press DIG to read it again.

Brown Links:
Use Brown Link to make a shareable link. You can share something directly with friends or hide it in the field for someone to discover.

Aura colors:
Give sparkles an aura color to organize them. Colors are for your own memory: ideas, links, personal notes, projects, reminders, or anything you choose. You can change the aura later.

Chest:
Dig up your chest to store sparkles safely. 🗃️ means empty. 🪎 means it holds stored sparkles. Field resets may bury the chest again, but the items inside stay safe.

Privacy:
Reliable mode is active. Normal sparkles and chest items stay readable after Safari reset, private mode, or device changes.

- - -

Field log / recent updates:
• Clipboard reading improved for GPT, Apple Notes and Brownlinks.
• The old question mark was removed.
• 🪏 now means: something can be buried here.
• Hidden Brownlinks are detected more reliably.
• Close, Copy and Delete are back in message views.
• Aura colors were added for sparkle organization.
• Aura colors can now be changed after choosing one.
• Field and chest sparkles now keep their true aura color.
• The chest was added as physical storage.
• Chest items show as sparkles, not text.
• Tap a chest sparkle to read it; Take Out appears in the detail view.
• The chest can be opened by tapping it.
• Finding the chest cleans the field holes.
• Rain drain direction was fixed.
• The message pill no longer covers open info boxes.
• The noticeboard was flattened and made easier to read.
• E2EE keys are now account-tied instead of only browser-tied.

• E2EE was softened into reliable account storage so saved sparkles do not become unreadable when browser keys disappear.

• Reliable mode restored: new sparkles and chest-items no longer depend on browser-only encryption keys.

This field is alive and being improved gently. 💛
